units.source_text: 世间原有一种女子，身份虽然高贵无比，心中却怀着几分淫荡之念。

en.t: There are indeed women in the world who, though of the highest rank, harbor a certain wantonness in their hearts.

units.source_text: 表面上威风凛凛，大模大样，而内心轻狂浮薄，另是一套。

en.t: Outwardly they look imposing and dignified, but inwardly they are frivolous and shallow, quite another matter altogether.

units.source_text: 此等人若被男子诱惑，立刻倾心相从，其例不胜枚举。

en.t: If such women are tempted by a man, they immediately give him their hearts and follow him, and there are countless examples of this.

units.source_text: 但三公主不是这等人。

en.t: But the Third Princess was not that kind of person.

units.source_text: 她虽然不是深明大义的人，然而生性胆小谨慎。

en.t: Although she was not someone with a profound understanding of moral principles, she was by nature timid and cautious.

units.source_text: 如今身逢此事，似觉众目昭彰，尽人皆知，不胜狼狈羞耻之情。

en.t: Now that this had happened to her, she felt as if it were plain to every eye and known to everyone, and she could hardly bear her confusion and shame.

units.source_text: 因此连明亮的地方也不敢出来，只管独自悲叹，痛惜此身命苦。

en.t: For that reason she dared not even come out into the light, but only grieved alone and lamented the bitter fate of her life.

units.source_text: 源氏正为紫夫人的病操心担忧，闻得三公主也不舒服，吃了一惊，

en.t: Genji was just then worrying anxiously over Lady Murasaki's illness, and when he heard that the Third Princess was also unwell, he was startled,

units.source_text: 不知她所患何疾，立刻回六条院来。

en.t: and not knowing what illness afflicted her, he immediately returned to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 但见三公主并无何等明显的病症，只是含羞不语，垂头丧气，

en.t: But he saw that the Third Princess had no particularly obvious symptoms; she only sat silent with shame, her head bowed and her spirits sunk,

units.source_text: 连源氏的脸也不看一看。

en.t: and would not even glance at Genji's face.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“大约是为了我久不来宿，她心中怨恨。”

en.t: Genji thought, "She is probably resentful because I have not come to stay with her for so long."

units.source_text: 他觉得很可怜，便把紫夫人的病况说给她听。

en.t: Feeling sorry for her, he told her about Lady Murasaki's condition.

units.source_text: 又对她说道：“照现在的病状看来，她已经是不中用的了。

en.t: He also said to her, "Judging from her present condition, she is already beyond help.

units.source_text: 此刻我不好意思对她冷淡。

en.t: At a time like this, I cannot bring myself to treat her coldly.

units.source_text: 况且她是从小由我抚养大来的，我不得不照顾到底，

en.t: Besides, I have raised her since she was a child, so I must look after her to the very end,

units.source_text: 因此近几月来忙得万事都顾不到。

en.t: and for these past few months I have been so busy that I could attend to nothing else.

units.source_text: 再过几时，你自会看到我的真心。”

en.t: After a little more time has passed, you will see my true heart for yourself."

units.source_text: 三公主看见源氏全不知情，心中越发难过，觉得很对他不起，

en.t: When the Third Princess saw that Genji knew nothing at all, her heart grew still more pained, and she felt deeply guilty toward him,

units.source_text: 只得偷偷地流泪。

en.t: so she could only shed tears in secret.
